create_dataset_map_provider: create a JsonIndexDatasetMapProvider to generate train, val, and test datasets from a CO3D-style dataset with JSON annotations
get_dataset_map: get the DatasetMap with train, val, and test datasets from a JsonIndexDatasetMapProvider instance
get_all_train_cameras: get all training cameras from a singlesequence JsonIndexDatasetMapProvider for camera analysis
dataset_tweak_args: tweak dataset constructor args by removing provider-controlled fields like dataset_root and subsets
get_co3d_set_names_mapping: get the CO3D subset names mapping for train, val, and test based on task type and test settings
